body:
S187-03/S188-05/S189-10 implemented in full: OAuth-based Back Office Drive browse+slurp (internal/drive/oauth.go, internal/http/handlers/admin_drive_slurp.go), background job queue with idempotency (Drive file ID + modifiedTime key) and bounded exponential-backoff retry, SSE live progress stream, double-click-confirm UI adapting EmilyOS's own timing-based confirmation concept. Wired into main.go (reuses GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) and admin.go (new nav link + routes). Real verification: go build/vet/test -race all clean across the whole repo, no regressions, including a real data race found and fixed (page() was reading job fields outside the lock the worker writes them under -- fixed via deep-copy under lock, then re-verified with -race). Files written directly to the real checkout but NOT git-committed (git operations blocked from this worktree) -- CHANGELOG.md itself got committed via 'emily changelog add' (which uses its own commit path, not blocked), but the actual code changes still need a manual git add+commit+push. Real, honest limitation: actually completing Google's OAuth consent screen needs a human in a browser, same category as the known MJOLNIR Firebase blocker (S189-31) -- code correctness is verified, the live round-trip is not.

⚓ ☃
title: Drive slurp feature built, real build+vet+test+race verified
